en.actionNextArrived: Reached the next episode; playback start is unconfirmed.
en.actionNextBlocked: Cannot advance to the next episode yet.
en.actionSeekUnavailable: The player cannot seek to this position yet.
en.actionSeekUnknown: Seek unconfirmed. Check the player; to recover, manually refresh the page and reopen the sidebar.
en.editConflict: Another window saved a newer version. Discard changes to edit from the latest settings.
en.editOldDraft: Draft from the previous player is retained. Edit only after the original player is confirmed.
en.editReadFailed: Could not read saved settings. Detect again.
en.editWriteUnknown: Save result is unconfirmed. Detect again to check the saved settings.
en.feedbackCannotReadPosition: Cannot read the playback time needed for this marker.
en.feedbackConflictPreserved: Settings changed in another window; the newer version was preserved.
en.feedbackDraftLost: Page or player changed; the previous draft was not saved.
en.feedbackInvalidated: Player duration or rules changed; changes were not saved.
en.feedbackMarkedDraft: Current time added to draft; player position and saved settings are unchanged.
en.feedbackNoSeek: No new seek confirmed. Check the current player state.
en.feedbackPageChangedPending: Page changed; checking the previous page's save.
en.feedbackPreviousUncertain: Could not verify the previous player's save; no retry was made.
en.feedbackQuota: Not enough local storage space; changes were not saved.
en.feedbackReadDifferent: Saved settings differ from these changes; save cannot be confirmed. Check and edit again.
en.feedbackReceiptUnverified: Write receipt received, but saved settings cannot be verified yet. Detect again.
en.feedbackReconcileFailed: Still cannot verify save. Detect again; saving will not be retried automatically.
en.feedbackSaveRejected: These settings cannot be saved yet. Detect again and verify.
en.feedbackSeekChanged: Player changed; seek cannot be verified.
en.feedbackSeekPending: Seek is still unconfirmed; checking player state.
en.feedbackSeekReceiptLost: Seek receipt was not returned. Player state will be checked; no automatic retry.
en.feedbackSeekTargetChanged: Player or duration changed. Verify before trying again.
en.feedbackUndoChanged: Original skip record changed; undo was not performed.
en.feedbackVersionChanged: Settings changed again after writing; verify the latest version.
en.invalidTime: Enter a valid time; start must be before end.
en.rangeHelp: Only changes the displayed timeline range, not the rules or playback position.
en.reasonAuth: This page is not authorized or access has expired. Check extension permissions.
en.reasonDurationChanged: Video duration changed; the previous position is invalid.
en.reasonLine: The next episode is unavailable on the current source.
en.reasonListGap: The next episode is missing; later episodes will not be skipped to.
en.reasonListIncomplete: Episode list is still loading; advance is paused.
en.reasonNavigation: Episode advance is unconfirmed; repeated advances are stopped.
en.reasonNextUnconfirmed: Could not uniquely identify the next episode; advance is paused.
en.reasonNoMedia: Could not identify a single main video player.
en.reasonNotSeekable: Current or target position is not seekable.
en.reasonSeekUnconfirmed: Seek was not confirmed; new seeks are paused.
en.reasonSiteNext: The site is advancing episodes; the assistant will not advance again.
en.resetOutroEnd: Set ending end to follow video end
en.scopeEpisodeHelp: Save for this episode. Work defaults are inherited only when compatibility has been verified.
en.scopeSeriesHelp: Save for this season of the series; episode overrides still take priority.
en.seekUnknownLong: Seek result is unconfirmed. Detect again only checks status; if still uncertain, inspect the player, refresh the page manually, and reopen the sidebar.
en.sliderEndBound: End, follows video end; edit in the time field
en.sliderIntroBound: 00:00, video start; edit in the time field
en.statusActivation: Check page features under Extensions → Page feature help, then detect again.
en.statusDisconnected: Cannot connect to this page right now. Detect again on the playback page.
en.statusLoading: Waiting for the page to load…
en.statusPermission: Cannot access this page. Check the assistant’s site permissions.
en.statusReload: The page feature must reload. Save your page work, finish ongoing actions, then refresh the playback page.
en.statusStarting: Page feature not connected. After first install or update, refresh the supported playback page once. If it still fails, check site access permissions.
en.statusUnsupported: Open a supported playback page in this tab.
en.summaryIyfNext: iYF handles the next episode; the assistant will not advance again.
en.summaryNextOn: On · continue in episode order after playback ends
en.tailBadRange: No usable ending interval for this video. Auto-skip will not run.
